description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Millathe, Dompe D/S Division, Gampha District (7844)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel titles, including changes to parcel numbers, land extents, servitude rights, and ownership details for various land parcels across different districts. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title amendments, and property-related legal modifications.
